assets-prod was publicly exposed, and I changed it to private. The console showed "설정이 변경되었습니다" (settings changed) after the toggle, and the page reloaded with the same row structure.

I could not visually confirm the final icon state, because the snapshot does not expose the switch's on/off state as text. The confirmation rests on two things: the `.switch.on` locator matched only the assets-prod switch before the click, and the toast appeared after it. I did not touch the other buckets, and I did not open the "버킷 비우기" (empty bucket) or "버킷 삭제" (delete bucket) options from the row menu.
